visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with two men walking through a tiled alleyway towards a street, wearing identical red sweatshirts and pants featuring vibrant God of Wealth graphics; the younger man smiles at the camera while the older man walks slightly behind him. (2) The scene cuts to the same pair walking on a city sidewalk in yellow t-shirts and shorts covered in a repetitive corn cob pattern; they are laughing and the younger man holds a black shoulder bag against a backdrop of modern urban storefronts. (3) They enter a brightly lit restaurant with dark wood wall panels and red booth seating; several other customers are visible in the background, appearing to stare at their unusual attire. (4) A series of close-up shots feature bowls of braised pork rice topped with soft-boiled eggs; the younger man uses chopsticks to mix the yolk into the rice while sitting at a light-colored wooden table. (5) The pair appears outdoors in front of lush green trees wearing green skeleton-print t-shirts; the younger man points to the ribcage design on the older man's shirt as they both laugh heartily under bright natural daylight. (6) Inside a spacious, high-ceilinged cafe with large glass windows showing a green field outside, they sit at a table eating chocolate ice cream from small paper cups. (7) Standing on a balcony under a bright blue sky, the younger man holds up a sleek black credit card toward the camera; the background shows distant green hills. (8) The visual shifts to clean graphic slides explaining credit card rewards and application forms, followed by a shot of the man using a silver laptop on a gray couch. (9) They are seen again in the red God of Wealth outfits outside a traditional storefront with a closed shutter, eventually moving inside to a dimly lit space where they consume bowls of dark herbal soup and noodles. (10) The final segments show the younger man in the driver's seat of a car and then on his living room couch, displaying two different credit cards towards the lens with expressive facial gestures.
